title: City Retreat - Rooftop Lounge
description:
Stunning, spacious luxury townhome conveniently situated within 3 miles of downtown Music City, with easy access to local attractions via Uber. Featuring 8 beds, ideal for accommodating large groups, the main floor boasts a stylish kitchen with generous seating, top-of-the-line appliances, a chic bar-style counter, and contemporary furnishings. Additionally, one garage space is provided for your convenience.

The space
The house is multiple levels with superb finishes and tons of space for large groups and families. It has multiple beds ranging from a comfy king all the way to the cozy double bunks. The home also features 3.5 bathrooms, a laundry area with brand new washer/dryer, comfortable sitting areas, and more. Each bedroom features ultra-comfy beds and storage for personal items.

The kitchen area has a fantastic bar seating area for entertaining, all updated appliances, and is fully stocked with cooking supplies, dishes, glassware, a coffee maker, and more. The living room is decorated with a contemporary mindset accompanied by a floating flat screen and cozy gray sofa. The living area was designed to maximize the feel of comfort and space, delivering a perfectly relaxing atmosphere.

★ Private Balcony
★ Modern Kitchen with Great Appliances
★ New Construction
★ Hottest Area in Nashville
★ High-Speed Wifi
★ Big Groups Welcome

★ Bedroom 1 - King Bed
★ Bedroom 2 - 2 Double over Double Bunk Beds
★ Bedroom 3 - 2 Queen Beds

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!
